scope.target: official Polymarket BTC five-minute Up or Down settlement
scope.independence: Polymarket owns discovery, market data, wallet, orders, positions, risk, PnL, settlement, pause, stop, and recovery. Binance has no credentials or execution path in this program.
scope.optional_external_input: Credential-free public BTCUSDT spot and USD-M futures observations may only improve, reduce, or veto a Polymarket decision.

parent_evidence.round14_capture_policy: Use the existing immutable 30-day campaign. Do not duplicate or mutate its raw capture.
parent_evidence.prior_round14_qualification_status: rejected and excluded from the active campaign
parent_evidence.round16_reason: The held-out challenger improved log loss and Brier score but failed the frozen balanced-accuracy non-inferiority gate.

feature_contract.causal_clock: Availability is determined only by local monotonic and UTC receipt time. Source time is retained for latency and drift checks but never moves an observation earlier than receipt.
feature_contract.gap_policy: No feature crosses a connection epoch, recorded gap, failed slot, market boundary, or partition boundary.
feature_contract.polymarket_trade_direction: Forbidden from the public feed. Directional executed flow requires exact on-chain CLOB V2 OrderFilled evidence joined by immutable identifiers.
feature_contract.normalization: Fit center, scale, clipping, and missingness policy on train only. Preserve missingness as explicit state; do not impute future or cross-gap values.
forbidden: Binance credentials, account, order, position, balance, capital, risk, or PnL state

controls: train-fitted monotone calibration of the Polymarket prior
candidate_layers: Chainlink plus Polymarket CLOB plus Binance spot
Chainlink plus Polymarket CLOB plus Binance spot and futures
candidates: regularized logistic residual on structural log odds
shallow LightGBM residual on structural log odds
small causal temporal convolution only after a simpler candidate passes development stability gates
model_contract.economic_objective: after-fee lower-confidence action utility using delayed executable CLOB depth, not classification accuracy
model_contract.selection: Use train and tune only, with contiguous event groups and purge. Search a bounded frozen grid. Prefer the simplest candidate within one standard error of the best tune objective.
model_contract.ai_boundary: AI is a separately evaluated preserve, reduce, or abstain layer. It cannot open exposure or increase size and is retained only after positive same-decision paired after-cost uplift.

partition.test_access: one use after immutable pretest model, threshold, cost, latency, and feature manifests
partition.insufficient_power: Extend collection under a new predeclared contract before test access. Never lower coverage or outcome gates.

promotion_gates.proper_score_requirement: Strictly improve log loss and Brier score over every control with positive event-block paired lower 95 percent bounds.
promotion_gates.classification_requirement: Balanced accuracy lower confidence exceeds 0.5 and is not lower than the strongest control.
promotion_gates.economic_requirement: Net PnL, mean event utility, median daily PnL, and the lower 95 percent bound of mean event utility are positive after all frozen costs.
promotion_gates.stress_requirement: Every frozen latency, depth, adverse-tick, and fee stress remains positive.
promotion_gates.risk_requirement: Profile drawdown and daily-loss ceilings pass pathwise with zero ownership, reconciliation, unknown-state, or lifecycle violations.

execution_contract.market_data: Polymarket CLOB V2 market WebSocket plus bounded REST reconciliation
execution_contract.ownership: Only exact ledger-owned parent-bound lots may be sold, hedged, settled, or redeemed.
execution_contract.heartbeat: Authenticated Polymarket heartbeat is mandatory; missed heartbeat cancels resting orders.
execution_contract.stop: Cancel bot orders, reconcile exact remote state, close or lock only ledger-owned exposure when executable, and keep retrying after connectivity returns.
execution_contract.unknown_state: Block new exposure. Reconcile before any recovery action.
